en:
Oh, hey Shuichi!
You seen Kokichi anywhere?

I saw him a while ago and tried to tell him
something, but he got away again.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kaito for a while?

You bored?
Then come help me find Kokichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I spent some time
looking for Kokichi.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I grew a little closer today.
